profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company headquartered in New York, NY, trading under the ticker DDOG. Its website describes it as offering cloud monitoring as a service, letting users see metrics from their apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial offered. The site also describes security and observability integration aimed at defending against AI-powered attacks, covering runtime execution, exposure in dynamic AI environments, and detection and response.

The company's own material positions it around cloud monitoring and, more recently, security and observability for AI environments. No specific AI products are tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed.

The record shows no lawsuits involving the company. It is associated with New York, where 459 cases are recorded in the law exposure data.
